design-reviewer.description: Reviews frontend products for visual design quality, anti-slop compliance, and design direction coherence. Use when auditing or reviewing visual design.

code-auditor.description: Audits frontend code for maintainability, design-system integrity, performance, and technical quality. Use when reviewing code quality or running code audits.

productizer.description: Transforms existing frontend code into marketplace-ready commercial products with documentation, packaging, and compliance. Use when productizing code for sale.
